Point to point

Airport → Paris (Thu)

A
Gary picks us up — text him when we land at 9:00am.
B
Or cab from the Harry Reid taxi line · ~15–25 min, ~$25–35 before tip. Allow extra time race week.

Paris → Turn 3 Grandstand

1
Exit Paris on the east side (Paris Dr) toward the Horseshoe & Paris monorail station.
2
Use the Main Entry just east of the station, then walk south through the Koval Zone to the Turn 3 Grandstand (near Entry 1). See the walking-route map.
3
About a 20–25 min walk. Leave 60–75 min before sessions to clear security and find seats.

Paris → Airport (Sun)

1
Leave Paris 6:15am by cab/rideshare (or Gary, if he offers).
2
At LAS by ~7:15am — two hours ahead for the 9:15am flight.

Evening walking routes

  • Thu: Paris → Horseshoe indoor walkway (The Lock, Jack Binion's) — never cross the track.
  • Fri: Flamingo Rd bridge over to the Cosmopolitan.
  • The Strip and parts of Koval/Harmon close during sessions — walk and use pedestrian bridges, not cars.
Race-week rules of the road
Re-entry: track-adjacent roads close ~1pm Thu–Sat, and one report says no venue re-entry after 7pm. Be inside before 7pm and confirm in the F1 LV app.
Tickets
Mobile only in the F1 Las Vegas app — keep phones charged. "Miles," the AI assistant in the app, answers live schedule and wayfinding questions.
Bags
Clear bags / small clutches. Check current rules at f1lasvegasgp.com before packing a day bag.
Weather
Mid-60s°F by day, mid-40s at night with wind in the grandstand. Very dry air — hydrate.
Tipping & cash
18–20% restaurants · $1–2/drink · $2–5/bag bell staff · 15–20% cabs. Bring cash; casino ATMs carry steep fees.

Zones & Turn 3 Grandstand

Main Entry → Koval Zone → Turn 3 Grandstand, with West Harmon (Performance Zone) to the south and East Harmon (main fan zone, Heineken Stage) across the track.

⤢ Enlarge
Your ticket covers Koval, East Harmon and West Harmon — all physically connected for 2026, so you can roam freely. Not included: T-Mobile Zone at Sphere, F1 Afterparty at Sphere, Paddock Club.
Koval Zone · home base
  • Cars at speed: cars come out of Turns 3 and 4 and run flat out up the Koval Straight — this is where you feel the speed.
  • Fan area: the Heineken-branded part of the circuit. In 2025: pop-ups, merch, and food like mojo pulled pork sandwiches, tri-tip nachos, ranch chicken sandwiches and Baja bowls.
  • Turn 3 Grandstand is newly relocated to the west side of Turn 3 for 2026. Sec TG1103 · Row 14 · Seats 7–9.
East Harmon · main fan zone
  • Heineken Stage (included) — Thu: The Australian Bee Gees Show, PACK Drumline, Super Cr3w · Fri: Icona Pop, Eli & Fur, Now You See Me Live · Sat: Disco Dom, LP Giobbi.
  • Driver Q&As: all 22 drivers take the stage across the weekend — set times not yet posted.
  • Track views: starting grid, pit lane, Turn 1 and the finish line.
  • 2025 extras: Pit Stop Challenge, team merch, and an Amex activation (design a livery, film a driver intro, giveaways).
  • F1 Academy paddock viewing (included) — Friday noon.
West Harmon · Performance Zone by WHOOP
  • Final-corner views: cars run down Harmon Straight to the final corner and checkered flag; lower rows look straight at pit-lane entry.
  • Smaller zone: food, merch and a few fan activations.

Speakeasy guide
No speakeasy inside Paris. The Lock at Horseshoe is closest via the indoor walkway. Cosmopolitan has three hidden bars under one roof — the easiest race-week crawl.
The Lock · HorseshoeBook
Nondescript door near the food court with a vintage phone — pick it up for the password, then crack a riddle.
SevenRooms · 833-855-2888
Pinky's by Vanderpump · FlamingoBook
Not hidden — Art Deco lounge on the casino floor; check in at the host stand.
702-777-3777
Beauty & Essex · Cosmo L3Book
Through the pawn shop to the back-left corner; hidden door opens to the restaurant/lounge.
Required for dinner · 702-737-0707
The Barbershop · Cosmo L1Book
Walk into the working barbershop; doorman at the "janitor" door lets you into the whiskey lounge (live rock).
Required for tables · 702-698-7434
Ghost Donkey · Cosmo L2Optional
Back of Block 16 food hall: plain door with a small donkey painted on it. Tiny mezcal bar.
Walk-in only
The Vault · BellagioOptional
Dark door left of the main cage; ask the host for "Charlotte." Rare vintage spirits.
Reservation strictly required · 866-906-7171

Packing list
  • Warm layers: insulated jacket, beanie, light gloves, warm socks
  • Clothing: 3 casual tops, 1 dressier shirt, 2 pants, base layer, sleepwear, 4× underwear & socks
  • Footwear: broken-in walking shoes + one nicer pair
  • Race gear: clear bag, foam earplugs, sunglasses, seat cushion if allowed
  • Tech: phone with F1 LV app + tickets, battery pack & cable, charger
  • Docs & money: ID, credit card, cash for tips/tables
  • Personal: toiletries (3-1-1), lip balm & lotion, daily meds
Open items
  • Bryan Johnson's flight — same Southwest flights as Pat
  • Airport → Paris — cab or Gary pickup
  • Third guest — confirm name, flight and room (seats 7–9 booked; room is 1 King)
  • Book Jack Binion's (Thu ~9:30pm)
  • Pick Fri dinner (~9:30pm) and Sat early dinner (~4pm)
  • Speakeasy reservations: The Lock & Pinky's (Thu) · Beauty & Essex & The Barbershop (Fri) · The Vault if wanted
  • Decide on F1 Arcade / F1 HUB visit
  • Optional: Friday single-day hospitality upgrade (Trackside Tavern) — $250 deposit · Aurora Rogers, ARogers@f1lasvegasgp.com
